# Contributing

Thanks for helping. Small, focused pull requests are easiest to review.

1. For a bug or task, open an [issue](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/issues/new/choose).
   For a larger idea, start a [discussion](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/discussions) first.
2. Fork the repository and branch from `main`.
3. Make the change and add a test when you change behaviour.
4. Run the tests for the part you touched:
   - Python: `pytest tests/unit`
   - Frontend: `cd dodaios/ui/web/frontend && npm install && npm run test`
5. Open a pull request and fill in the template. Show a screenshot when the interface changes.

Code, comments, commit messages and docs are written in English.

Security problems go through the [security policy](https://github.com/Dodaios/Dodaios/security/policy), not a public issue.
